entries.subject: DAMIT 319: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-319.txt. Model 319, version 2011-04-21, pole (250°, 17°), period 5.65534 h match the retained metadata. The archive diameter field is 109 ±11 km; its applicability to our scale is a separate calibration decision. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: AKARI thermal diameter as an alternative scale
entries.finding: [AKARI AcuA](https://data.darts.isas.jaxa.jp/pub/akari/AKARI-IRC_Catalogue_AllSky_AcuA_1.0/) — retained for comparison; the selected archive model has a physical size calibration. Its fitted nonrotating-sphere diameter is 132.74 ± 1.52 km. Formal catalog error omits additional shape, spin and thermal-model effects; no total confidence interval is invented. The original catalogue row for asteroid 69 was retrieved again and matched field-for-field with the retained row, including diameter, reported error and detection count.
entries.revisitWhen: A source-specific comparison with the selected shape and physical calibration justifies changing the adopted scale.

entries.subject: Resolved-model surveys: body-specific candidate not established
entries.finding: The imported survey cites Hanuš 2017, Viikinkoski 2017 and Vernazza 2021 without identifying a selected product for this body. The current DAMIT reference join does not bind selected model 319 to those surveys. This does not prove that no resolved model exists elsewhere; a body-specific candidate and its release must be identified before the entry can count as included.
entries.revisitWhen: A target row, supplementary model or release URL from one of these surveys establishes a concrete candidate and permits comparison with the selected shape.

entries.subject: Shape and spin alternatives
entries.finding: Alternative archive solutions: model 320, pole ['71', '-2'], [Model 320](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/asteroid_models/view/320) The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 320: pole (71°, -2°), 5.65534 h, version 2011-04-21, archive diameter 109 km. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: A released numerical replacement or independent pole/size constraints that distinguish the recorded alternatives, followed by comparison against the currently selected model.
